title.narrative: Provide lifesaving and sustainable access to WASH services to drought affected displaced populations and host communities in Berdale.

description.narrative:
ltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtCESDO proposes to implement lifesaving WASH services with a durable solution component to address WASH gaps in Berdale IDP sites and rural villages. The project aims to improve temporary access to water through water distribution network extension, water kiosks construction, emergency water supply, water trucking in 5 villages in Berdale. To address sanitation gaps and promote safe hygiene practices, CESDO will construct emergency sanitation facilities, distribute hygiene supplies and undertake hygiene promotion activities targeting Berdale IDP sites. To prevent water shortage triggered displacement the project seeks to improve sustainable access to water by rehabilitating 3 shallow wells in rural villages in Berdale. This project takes into account the protection risks facing women and girls and to reduce these risks, protection is mainstreamed in all activities. Gender and disability inclusion are also fundamental component of the project and will be fostered from inception phase through implementation by conducting consultations with these groups to identify their preferences in terms of assistance delivery. Community participation and consultation at all stages of activities implementation will be ensured while minority inclusion and accountability to affected population are key pillars of the project lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
ltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtCESDO will coordinate with health and nutrition partners targeting the same population groups to reduce diseases and malnutrition related morbidity and mortality. Working with protection, shelter and CCCM partners, the projects improves service delivery in IDP sites.lt/spangt
